query: I'm designing "KEP-2885: Server Side Unknown Field Validation" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering an alternative approach instead of whatever was ultimately chosen. What does this project's history say about alternatives that were already considered here, and why weren't they used?
response:
Based on the provided chunks from `keps/sig-api-machinery/2885-server-side-unknown-field-validation/README.md`, the document discusses the existing client-side approach (`kubectl --validate=true`) and details why client-side validation is problematic:

* **Slow adoption of bug fixes:** Bug fixes take longer for users to receive because client-side upgrades are difficult to distribute to everyone.
* **Redundant implementation:** Every individual client is required to implement its own validation logic.
* **Maintenance difficulty:** Client-side validation is noted as being "very painful" (cited in [kubernetes/kubernetes#39434](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/39434#issuecomment-270443399)).
* **Deprecation goal:** Implementing server-side validation is identified as the final step needed to remove client-side validation altogether (cited in [kubernetes/kubernetes#39434](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/39434#issuecomment-270486105); additional discussion in [kubernetes/kubernetes#5889](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/5889) and [kubernetes/kubernetes#104090](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/104090#issuecomment-895228540)).

*(Note: The Table of Contents mentions a section titled "Out-of-Tree Alternatives to Client Side Validation" under "Future Work," but the text of that section is not included in the retrieved chunks.)*
